en.question: How do you determine whether a failure originates in the integration layer or in the model's output?

options.text: Model failures surface as HTTP errors, whereas integration failures do not.
options.note: Model quality failures return HTTP 200, which is what makes them hard to catch.

options.text: Integration failures only appear under high load, so reproduce at peak traffic.
options.note: Integration bugs frequently appear on specific inputs at any load.

options.text: Inspect the raw response: well-formed but wrong points at the prompt or model.
Model failures are always reproducible when temperature is set to zero.
options.note: Temperature 0 reduces variation but does not guarantee reproducibility.

en.explanation: The raw response separates the two. A malformed request, a wrong parameter, an unhandled stop_reason, or a bad tool result points at your code instead.
